sides.text: A 5 V supply drives a red LED (Vf = 2 V) at 20 mA. Which series resistor is needed?
Which Wi-Fi generation introduced OFDMA?
C. Wi-Fi 6
A 5%-droop generator runs at 60 Hz with no load. What is its frequency at full load?
D. 57 Hz
An ADC has a SINAD of 62 dB. What is its ENOB?
D. About 10 bits
Which scheduler can reach 100% utilization on a single core?
B. Earliest deadline first

more.text: EDF is optimal for preemptive single-processor scheduling.

sides.text: A 16 MHz clock has a prescaler of 64 and a count of 250. What frequency results?
Which HVDC converter type can black-start a dead grid?
D. Voltage-source converter (VSC)

more.text: VSCs don't need a strong AC grid to commutate.

sides.text: What is the phase offset between phases in a 4-phase interleaved buck converter?
Which unit measures capacitance?
A. Farad

more.text: The farad. Henries measure inductance and coulombs measure charge.

sides.text: A 10:1 step-down transformer has 120 V in. What is the output?
A. 12 V

more.text: The voltage ratio equals the turns ratio, so 120 / 10 = 12 V.

sides.text: What is the wavelength of a 100 MHz radio signal?
B. 3 m
What is the maximum theoretical efficiency of a class B amplifier?
A. About 78.5%
To measure the current through a load, how should a multimeter be connected?
options: Across the supply with the load removed

sides.text: B. In series with the load

more.text: Current must flow through the meter, so it's connected in series.

sides.text: A 100 µF capacitor is charged to 5 V. How much charge does it hold?
C. 500 µC
An RC low-pass filter has R = 1.6 kΩ and C = 100 nF. What is its cutoff frequency?
B. About 995 Hz
Which PID term removes steady-state error?
C. Integral

more.text: Integral action accumulates the error until it's zero.

sides.text: What is 1101 in binary as a decimal number?
An inverting amplifier has Rf = 100 kΩ and Rin = 10 kΩ. What is the gain?
What does a differential pair reject?
C. Common-mode signals

more.text: It amplifies the difference between inputs.

sides.text: What does an OFDM cyclic prefix handle?
D. Multipath delay spread

more.text: It absorbs delay spread to avoid intersymbol interference.

sides.text: In an integer-N PLL, what is the output frequency?
A. N × f_ref

more.text: The divider forces f_out / N = f_ref.

sides.text: A power loop has 10 nH of inductance and switches at 1 A/ns. How large is the voltage spike?
C. 10 V
A 9 V source feeds a 6 kΩ resistor in series with a 3 kΩ resistor. What is the voltage across the 3 kΩ resistor?
D. 3 V
An induction motor has a synchronous speed of 1,800 rpm and runs at 1,750 rpm. What is the slip?
C. About 2.8%
Which radio method varies the carrier's frequency to carry the signal?
D. FM

more.text: FM varies frequency; AM varies amplitude.

sides.text: What is the reactance of a 1 µF capacitor at 1 kHz?
C. About 159 Ω
An air-filled WR-90 waveguide has a = 2.286 cm. What is the TE₁₀ cutoff?
C. About 6.56 GHz
Which component stores energy in a magnetic field?
B. Inductor

more.text: Inductors store energy in magnetic fields; capacitors in electric fields.

sides.text: Which bus decides priority by message ID, with the lowest ID winning?
A. CAN

more.text: CAN uses bitwise arbitration on the ID.

sides.text: A 1 V rail with ±5% tolerance sees a 5 A load step. What is the target PDN impedance?
C. 10 mΩ
Which regulator type is more efficient when the input and output voltages differ greatly?
C. Switching

more.text: A switching regulator doesn't burn the excess voltage as heat.

sides.text: What is 20 dBm in milliwatts?
D. 100 mW

more.text: 0 dBm = 1 mW, and each 10 dB is ×10.

sides.text: A MOSFET has μCox = 100 µA/V², W/L = 20, and Vov = 0.2 V. What is I_D?
B. 40 µA
A coin lands heads 25% of the time. What is its entropy?
A. About 0.81 bits
What anchors a secure boot chain of trust?
D. A hardware root of trust

more.text: Immutable ROM and keys anchor verification.

sides.text: A BJT has β = 100 and a base current of 50 µA. What is the collector current?
A. 5 mA
A channel has B = 1 MHz and a linear SNR of 31. What is the Shannon capacity?
B. 5 Mbit/s
Why do power lines use very high voltage?
options: To reduce current and I²R loss
To make them safe to touch

sides.text: A. To reduce current and I²R loss

more.text: For the same power, higher voltage means lower current and much lower loss.

sides.text: A fundamental of 100 V has a 5 V fifth harmonic and a 3 V seventh. What is the THD?
C. About 5.8%
What prevents both switches of a half-bridge conducting at once?
B. Dead time

more.text: Dead time delays turn-on after turn-off.

sides.text: Which system is stable: a pole at s = −3 or a pole at s = +2?
D. The pole at −3

more.text: Stable poles lie in the left half-plane.

sides.text: How many comparison cycles does a 12-bit SAR ADC need per conversion?
A signal is 1 mW and the noise is 1 µW. What is the SNR in dB?
A. 30 dB
A 7 kHz tone is sampled at 10 kHz. At what frequency does it appear?
A. 3 kHz
L = 10 mH and C = 100 nF. What is the resonant frequency?
C. About 5.03 kHz
Which MOSFET dimension increases output resistance when it grows?
C. Channel length
A sine wave is 3.3 V peak-to-peak. What is its RMS value?
D. About 1.17 V

more.text: Vp = 1.65 V, and RMS = Vp / √2 ≈ 1.17 V.

sides.text: A 60 W bulb runs for 5 hours. How much energy does it use?
D. 0.3 kWh
A quarter-wave line matches 50 Ω to 200 Ω. What impedance must the line have?
A boost converter has Vin = 5 V and D = 0.5. What is Vout?
A. 10 V
A relay coil is switched off by a transistor. What protects the transistor?
D. A flyback diode

more.text: The coil's collapsing field creates a spike. The diode gives it a safe path.

sides.text: Two 100 Ω resistors are in parallel. What is the total resistance?
C. 50 Ω

more.text: Equal resistors in parallel give half the value.

sides.text: What is the maximum Doppler shift at 2 GHz and 30 m/s?
C. 200 Hz
Which bus uses only two signal wires, SDA and SCL?
C. I2C

more.text: I2C uses SDA and SCL with pull-ups.

sides.text: At 115,200 baud with 8N1 framing, about how many bytes per second can UART move?
C. About 11,520

more.text: Each byte uses 10 bits on the wire.

sides.text: Which MCU feature reacts immediately to a rare event without polling?
C. Interrupt

more.text: Interrupts pause the main program for the event.

sides.text: A 12 V battery is connected across a 240 Ω resistor. What current flows?
C. 50 mA
A three-phase load draws 10 A at 400 V line voltage with pf 0.9. What is the real power?
C. About 6.2 kW
A second-order system has ζ = 0.5. What is the approximate step overshoot?
C. About 16%
Which of these is a full computer running Linux?
C. Raspberry Pi

more.text: The Raspberry Pi runs Linux. The others are microcontrollers.
